why: A is the abstract transport theory of an arbitrary LocalTransport: any family O x, good open sets covering X_inf, and push-forwards that compose. It covers dyadic transport, Lebesgue numbers, (*), homotopy invariance, reparametrization, concatenation and uniqueness, plus equiv_paste_squares (taken at Sort 1 = Type). It mentions no orientations, HasLocalPropagation or contractibility. B is concrete. For EVERY tame X and EVERY sc-Fredholm f (no bump functions, no tame section, no sc+-sections), part (a) gives each smooth point an open, sc-smoothly contractible neighbourhood with the local propagation property (B_implies_orNbhdCover, rt_check OK). The project never proves this: Theorem 6.35 gives open propagation sets only under bump functions plus a tame section, and never contractible ones. So A => B would need orLocalTransport (V6_57's extra hypotheses) and this cover. The cover is also what B's (b) existence and B's (d) need (see V6_57 A_to_BExtra). B => A cannot hold, because B concerns one instance and A every LocalTransport.
overlap: No direction proved, so no #rt_overlap. The auxiliary lemma B_implies_orNbhdCover (B's (a) applied to the constant path) passes #rt_check.
